description: A span paints its own color and background-color behind its own text only.

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 7.40% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 12.35% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
